run_inverse_kinematics_simulation: run the pybullet simulation that controls a Kuka arm mounted on a Husky mobile base using inverse kinematics
create_iterative_ik_solver: create a function that iteratively refines inverse kinematics joint poses until the end effector is within a distance threshold of the target position
calculate_inverse_kinematics_with_null_s: calculate inverse kinematics for a 7-DOF robot arm using null space rest poses, joint limits, and joint ranges
create_robot_constraint: create a fixed joint constraint to mount a Kuka robot arm on top of a Husky mobile base in pybullet
control_robot_joints_with_motor: control robot arm joint positions using pybullet setJointMotorControl2 with position control mode and configurable force and gain parameters
